Mel, here is the Cocktail Catamaran with the lighter bar you asked about. Same boat, same sunset sail, now with a relaxed open bar and a freshly prepared menu you choose for your group.

Your Welcome Party
Thursday 18 February · Two days before your wedding
Flamingo to Tamarindo
The Cocktail Catamaran
Panache, a private 45 ft Lagoon sailing catamaran, set up as a cocktail party rather than a tour.

The whole group shares one wide, open deck, so it feels like a party, not a boat trip. The bar pours easy, fun cocktails, wine and prosecco all afternoon, and the food is a full menu you pick for your group, from garlic shrimp to beef skewers with guacamole. It boards in Flamingo and finishes in Tamarindo, so most of your guests step off a short ride from where they are staying.

Why you might love it
  • Everyone together, on one deck, the whole time
  • A relaxed open bar all afternoon
  • A real meal on board, with something for every guest

  • Ending in Tamarindo saves most guests the drive back
